settings.label: Client ID
settings.help: Your Spotify Web API app Client ID. Add http://127.0.0.1:43110/callback as its redirect URI.

settings.label: Soloist API Key
settings.help: Your personal Soloist API key (separate from Client ID). Optional if already saved via the local helper script.

settings.label: Disable LRCLIB lyrics
settings.help: Turn on to stop querying lrclib.net for synchronized lyrics.

settings.label: Disable NetEase Cloud Music lyrics
settings.help: Turn on to stop querying NetEase Cloud Music for bilingual lyrics.

settings.label: Disable QQ Music lyrics
settings.help: Turn on to stop querying QQ Music for bilingual lyrics.
